_comment_bedrock_glm: zai.glm-5 is a non-Claude Bedrock model, so the bedrock provider's apiFor() routes it to Converse automatically (no "api" field needed on the target — that field only exists to override the default). If your account/region rejects the direct model id, switch it to the apac. cross-region inference profile (e.g. "apac.zai.glm-5") instead.
_comment_models: The model key is what Claude Code must send as ANTHROPIC_MODEL — it has to match exactly, since the bedrock provider forwards tool/message content but never rewrites the client-facing model name.
_comment_pricing: There is no bundled rate for non-Claude Bedrock models, so this route needs an explicit override or it settles at 0 microUSD with missing=true. input_per_mtok/output_per_mtok are plain USD-per-million-tokens (converted to integer microUSD internally at settlement); the three cache rates derive from input (0.1x / 1.25x / 2x) unless you set them. The two figures below are the AWS-published on-demand rates for zai.glm-5 in ap-northeast-1 ($0.0012 and $0.00384 per 1K tokens, Price List publication 2026-08-26) — regenerate them for your own region with `mayu pricing sync --config <this file>`, which reads the AWS Price List API offline and never runs on the request path. A 0/0 override is now a LOAD ERROR: 0 means unpriced, not free. Set "free": true only for a model you know is genuinely zero-cost.
